title: AG60130: Environmental Microbiology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to environmental microbiology, Microbial growth and enzyme
kinetics, metabotic pathways; Pollutants: types, nature and sources, analytical
techniques in environment monitoring; Pretreatment and handling of hazardous
wastes, microbiological and biochemical aspects of waste treatment,
characteristics of wastewaters, aerobic and anaerobic wastewater treatment
processes: activated sludge process, trickling filter, lagooning process,
rotary disc biological contractor, photosynthetic wastewater treatment,
effluent disposal and reuse; Biological treatment of solid wastes,
Biomethenation, Downstream processing of biological waste treatment processes,
Composting and vermicomposting, Biofertilizer, Biofuel (biodiesel, bioethanol,
biohydrogen), Bioremediation of heavy metals, xenobiotics and hazardous wastes,
Biomarker, Biosensor.
